mechanics.claim: Ornn's basic attacks on-hit against Brittle enemies knock them back; other allied/Ornn immobilize or silence effects instead consume Brittle for bonus magic damage and extended CC.
mechanics.quote: His {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against enemies afflicted with ''Brittle'' are empowered to {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} a short distance

mechanics.claim: Brittle is applied by hits from Bellows Breath (W) and Call of the Forge God (R).
mechanics.quote: '''Ornn''' applies {{tip|Brittle}} to enemies hit by ''{{ai|Bellows Breath|Ornn}}'' and ''{{ai|Call of the Forge God|Ornn}}''

mechanics.claim: A basic attack against a Brittle target ends the debuff on-hit even without the knockback landing, but this does not trigger the bonus damage from consumption unless the target is an epic monster.
mechanics.quote: '''Ornn's''' basic attacks against {{tip|Brittle}} enemies will end the duration of the debuff {{tip|on-hit}} prematurely even if the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} was not applied. This does not trigger the consumed effect that deals the bonus damage, unless the target was an epic {{tip|monster}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks both the knockback and the bonus damage from the empowered Brittle attack.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the knock back and the bonus damage from '''Ornn's''' empowered {{tip|brittle}} attack.

mechanics.claim: The Brittle-consumption bonus magic damage is credited to Ornn and scales with his magic penetration.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} inflicted by ''Brittle'' is credited to '''Ornn''', and benefits from his {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The Master Craftsman stat amplification applies to bonus armor, bonus magic resistance and bonus health from all sources, relevant to survival (damage taken).
mechanics.quote: '''Ornn''' increases his {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}} by 10% from all sources

mechanics.claim: The Living Forge channel to purchase or upgrade items is interrupted if Ornn takes damage from enemy champions or turrets, and is unrelated to dealing or taking combat damage otherwise.
mechanics.quote: The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} if '''Ornn''' takes damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}
